[package]
authors = ["The Cranelift Project Developers"]
name = "cranelift"
version = "0.139.0-dev"
description = "Umbrella for commonly-used cranelift crates"
license = "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/cranelift"
repository = "https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime"
categories = ["no-std"]
keywords = ["compile", "compiler", "jit"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.97.0"

[lints.rust]
unused_extern_crates = "warn"
trivial_numeric_casts = "warn"
unstable_features = "warn"
unused_import_braces = "warn"
unused_lifetimes = "warn"
unused_macro_rules = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(pulley_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_assume_llvm_makes_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_disable_interp_simd)", "cfg(arc_try_new)", "cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(gc_zeal)"]

[lints.clippy]
clone_on_copy = "warn"
map_clone = "warn"
uninlined_format_args = "warn"
unnecessary_to_owned = "warn"
manual_strip = "warn"
useless_conversion = "warn"
unnecessary_mut_passed = "warn"
unnecessary_fallible_conversions = "warn"
unnecessary_cast = "warn"
allow_attributes_without_reason = "warn"
from_over_into = "warn"
redundant_field_names = "warn"
multiple_bound_locations = "warn"
extra_unused_type_parameters = "warn"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "allow"
priority = -1

[dependencies.cranelift-codegen]
path = "cranelift/codegen"
version = "0.139.0-dev"
default-features = false
features = ["unwind"]

[dependencies.cranelift-frontend]
optional = true
path = "cranelift/frontend"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

[dependencies.cranelift-interpreter]
optional = true
path = "cranelift/interpreter"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

[dependencies.cranelift-jit]
optional = true
path = "cranelift/jit"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

[dependencies.cranelift-module]
optional = true
path = "cranelift/module"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

[dependencies.cranelift-native]
optional = true
path = "cranelift/native"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

[dependencies.cranelift-object]
optional = true
path = "cranelift/object"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

[features]
default = ["std", "frontend"]
frontend = ["dep:cranelift-frontend"]
interpreter = ["dep:cranelift-interpreter"]
jit = ["dep:cranelift-jit"]
module = ["dep:cranelift-module"]
native = ["dep:cranelift-native"]
object = ["dep:cranelift-object"]
std = ["cranelift-codegen/std", "cranelift-frontend?/std", "cranelift-module?/std"]
core = ["cranelift-codegen/core", "cranelift-frontend?/core", "cranelift-module?/core"]

[package]
name = "cranelift-assembler-x64"
description = "A Cranelift-specific x64 assembler"
version = "0.139.0-dev"
license = "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.97.0"

[dependencies.arbitrary]
features = ["derive"]
optional = true
version = "1.4.2"

[dependencies.capstone]
optional = true
version = "0.14.0"
default-features = false
features = ["full", "arch_x86", "arch_riscv", "arch_arm64", "arch_sysz"]

[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"x86_64\", target_os = \"linux\"))".dependencies.xed-sys]
optional = true
version = "0.6"

[dev-dependencies]
arbtest = "0.3.2"

[dev-dependencies.arbitrary]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.4.2"

[dev-dependencies.capstone]
version = "0.14.0"

features = ["full", "arch_x86", "arch_riscv", "arch_arm64", "arch_sysz"]

[build-dependencies.cranelift-assembler-x64-meta]
path = "meta"
version = "0.139.0-dev"

unused_extern_crates = "warn"
trivial_numeric_casts = "warn"
unstable_features = "warn"
unused_import_braces = "warn"

check-cfg = ["cfg(pulley_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_assume_llvm_makes_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_disable_interp_simd)", "cfg(arc_try_new)", "cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(gc_zeal)"]

unnecessary_cast = "warn"
allow_attributes_without_reason = "warn"

multiple_bound_locations = "warn"
extra_unused_type_parameters = "warn"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "allow"
priority = -1

[features]
fuzz = ["dep:arbitrary", "dep:capstone"]
fuzz-xed = ["fuzz", "dep:xed-sys"]

[build-dependencies.cranelift-isle]
path = "../isle/isle"
version = "=0.139.0-dev"

[features]
default = ["std", "unwind", "host-arch", "timing"]
std = ["serde?/std", "rustc-hash/std", "gimli/std", "cranelift-control/fuzz"]
core = []
disas = ["anyhow", "capstone"]
trace-log = ["regalloc2/trace-log"]
isle-split-match = []
unwind = ["gimli"]
x86 = []
arm64 = []
s390x = []
riscv64 = []
pulley = ["pulley-fallback"]
pulley-fallback = ["dep:pulley-interpreter", "pulley-interpreter/encode", "pulley-interpreter/disas", "cranelift-codegen-meta/pulley"]
host-arch = []
all-arch = ["all-native-arch", "pulley"]
all-native-arch = ["x86", "arm64", "s390x", "riscv64"]
enable-serde = ["serde", "serde_derive", "cranelift-entity/enable-serde", "cranelift-bitset/enable-serde", "regalloc2/enable-serde", "hashbrown/serde", "smallvec/serde"]
incremental-cache = ["enable-serde", "postcard", "sha2"]
souper-harvest = ["souper-ir", "souper-ir/stringify"]
isle-errors = ["cranelift-isle/fancy-errors"]

authors = ["henrylee2cn <henrylee2cn@gmail.com>", "dignifiedquire <me@dignifiedquire.com>", "Dan Burkert <dan@danburkert.com>"]
license = "MIT/Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/henrylee2cn/mmapio"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/mmapio"
description = "Cross-platform Rust API for memory-mapped file IO"
keywords = ["mmap", "memory-map", "io", "file"]
edition = "2018"

[target."cfg(unix)".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.winapi]
version = "0.3"
features = ["basetsd", "handleapi", "memoryapi", "minwindef", "std", "sysinfoapi"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempdir = "0.3"

[package]
authors = ["The Wasmtime Project Developers"]
description = "INTERNAL: Wasmtime's core utilities and helpers with minimal dependencies"
edition = "2024"
license = "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception"
name = "wasmtime-internal-core"
rust-version = "1.97.0"
version = "52.0.0-dev"

[dependencies]
libm = "0.2.16"

[dependencies.anyhow]
optional = true
version = "1.0.103"
default-features = false

[dependencies.hashbrown]
features = ["default-hasher"]
version = "0.17"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
optional = true
version = "1.0.228"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc"]

[lints.rust]
unused_extern_crates = "warn"
trivial_numeric_casts = "warn"
unstable_features = "warn"
unused_import_braces = "warn"
unused_lifetimes = "warn"
unused_macro_rules = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(pulley_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_assume_llvm_makes_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_disable_interp_simd)", "cfg(arc_try_new)", "cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(gc_zeal)"]

[lints.clippy]
clone_on_copy = "warn"
map_clone = "warn"
uninlined_format_args = "warn"
unnecessary_to_owned = "warn"
manual_strip = "warn"
useless_conversion = "warn"
unnecessary_mut_passed = "warn"
unnecessary_fallible_conversions = "warn"
unnecessary_cast = "warn"
allow_attributes_without_reason = "warn"
from_over_into = "warn"
redundant_field_names = "warn"
multiple_bound_locations = "warn"
extra_unused_type_parameters = "warn"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "allow"
priority = -1

[features]
std = []
backtrace = ["std"]
anyhow = ["dep:anyhow"]
serde = ["dep:serde"]

[package]
name = "wasmtime-internal-jit-icache-coherence"
version = "52.0.0-dev"
authors = ["The Wasmtime Project Developers"]
description = "INTERNAL: Utilities for JIT icache maintenance"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/jit-icache-coherence"
license = "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception"
repository = "https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.97.0"

[lints.rust]
unused_extern_crates = "warn"
trivial_numeric_casts = "warn"
unstable_features = "warn"
unused_import_braces = "warn"
unused_lifetimes = "warn"
unused_macro_rules = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(pulley_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_assume_llvm_makes_tail_calls)", "cfg(pulley_disable_interp_simd)", "cfg(arc_try_new)", "cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(gc_zeal)"]

[lints.clippy]
clone_on_copy = "warn"
map_clone = "warn"
uninlined_format_args = "warn"
unnecessary_to_owned = "warn"
manual_strip = "warn"
useless_conversion = "warn"
unnecessary_mut_passed = "warn"
unnecessary_fallible_conversions = "warn"
unnecessary_cast = "warn"
allow_attributes_without_reason = "warn"
from_over_into = "warn"
redundant_field_names = "warn"
multiple_bound_locations = "warn"
extra_unused_type_parameters = "warn"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "allow"
priority = -1

[dependencies.wasmtime-core]
path = "crates/core"
version = "=52.0.0-dev"
package = "wasmtime-internal-core"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows-sys]
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_Diagnostics_Debug"]
version = "0.61.2"

[target."cfg(all(not(miri), target_arch = \"aarch64\", any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"android\")))".dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2.190"
default-features = true

[target."cfg(all(not(miri), target_arch = \"riscv64\", target_os = \"linux\"))".dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2.190"
default-features = true

[target."cfg(all(not(miri), target_arch = \"aarch64\", any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"android\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"macos\")))".dev-dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2.190"
default-features = true

[features]
one-core = []

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/microlift/wasmtime"]
git = "https://github.com/microlift/wasmtime"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "microlift_experimental"

[source."https://github.com/microlift/function_traits"]
git = "https://github.com/microlift/function_traits"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/microlift/microlift"]
git = "https://github.com/microlift/microlift"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "2da7446d8ff1e468b196cf7d103bbaed2c5870ab"

[source."https://github.com/microlift/mmapio"]
git = "https://github.com/microlift/mmapio"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
